summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MeetFlow 1:1 Booking Page feature (Phase 2). All 18 backend tests pass. Frontend UI fully functional - Booking Settings page, Public Booking page with calendar, slot selection, and booking confirmation all working correctly.

Backend: PUT /api/booking/availability saves weekday schedule, slot duration, buffer, blocked dates
Backend: GET /api/book/{username}/info returns public user info (name, avatar, slot_duration, booking_enabled)
Backend: GET /api/book/{username}/slots?date=YYYY-MM-DD returns available time slots for that date
Backend: Slots respect weekday enabled/disabled settings (no slots on disabled days like Saturday)
Backend: Slots respect blocked_dates (no slots on blocked dates)
Backend: POST /api/book/{username} creates booking + MeetFlow meeting, returns booking_id + meeting_code
Backend: Double booking returns 409 Conflict
Backend: Booked slot disappears from available slots
Backend: GET /api/booking/my-bookings lists user's bookings with pagination
Backend: DELETE /api/booking/{booking_id} cancels booking
Backend: All auth endpoints return 401 when not authenticated
Backend: Invalid date format returns 400
Backend: Non-existent user returns 404
Backend: Missing required fields returns 400
Backend: Non-existent booking returns 404 on cancel
Frontend Booking Settings /booking/settings: Shows booking URL, weekday toggles, time inputs, slot duration, buffer, blocked dates
Frontend Booking Settings: Save availability persists changes with success toast 'Verfuegbarkeit gespeichert'
Frontend Booking Settings: Copy booking URL button works
Frontend Booking Settings: Add/remove blocked dates works
Frontend Public Booking /book/{username}: Shows user header with avatar, name, slot duration
Frontend Public Booking: Mini calendar with date selection (past dates disabled, today highlighted)

context_for_next_testing_agent: 1:1 Booking Page feature fully tested. Key endpoints: GET/PUT /api/booking/availability (auth required), GET /api/book/{username}/info (public), GET /api/book/{username}/slots?date=YYYY-MM-DD (public), POST /api/book/{username} (public, creates booking + meeting), GET /api/booking/my-bookings (auth), DELETE /api/booking/{booking_id} (auth). Frontend pages: /booking/settings (auth required), /book/{username} (public). Availability config: Mon-Fri enabled (Wed 10-16, Fri 9-12, others 9-17), Sat-Sun disabled, 30min slots, 10min buffer. Email sending is MOCKED.

mocked_apis.email_sending: Email sending is simulated (logged to console) without valid Resend/SendGrid API key

notes: The 1:1 Booking Page feature is fully functional. Users can configure availability (weekdays, times, slot duration, buffer, blocked dates) via /booking/settings. External persons can book directly via /book/{username} without login. Booking creates a MeetFlow meeting with meeting_type=scheduled. Double-booking prevention works correctly (409 Conflict). Booked slots are removed from available slots. The mini calendar correctly disables past dates and shows no slots for disabled weekdays or blocked dates.
